items.html: The third head, which is called the Hochma, the Mocha Stima'ah of AA, has in it also three other names: Yod-He-Vav-He, Yod-He-Vav-He, Yod-He-Vav-He, in the filling of MAH of Alpin, in the vowels of the second head, which are Segol in place of Tzere. And there is added in these a second change, that also in place of the vocalization of Kamatz, in these there is the vocalization of Patach instead of the Kamatz. And all three of them — inner light, surrounding, and surrounding of both of them — are in the aspect of particularity. But in the aspect of the generality, all these three discernments are only the aspect of the inner light alone of the three heads mentioned above.
